originalSubject: [Readly] Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution

payload.subject: [Readly] Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution
payload.text:
Hello Readly team,

Thank you - Martin's reply with the publisher form is appreciated. We are filling out the publisher form at https://se.readly.com/publishers_info today on behalf of Hashtag Web3.

To make the application complete, the details it will carry:

- Publisher: Hashtag Web3 - United States organization publishing English-language crypto and Web3 news
- Publication: https://hashtagweb3.com/news
- RSS feed: https://hashtagweb3.com/news/feed.xml (headlines, summaries, original publication dates, canonical links)
- Example native article: https://hashtagweb3.com/bitgetthai
- About: https://hashtagweb3.com/about
- Contact: hi@hashtagweb3.com

Reach context: 55 million job-post views in the last year, 26 million LinkedIn views last month, 150,000 newsletter subscribers, 60,000 Telegram members, weekly X Spaces with 20,000-40,000 listeners.

Editorial note: our workflow uses AI-assisted research and drafting with source and publication checks. Anything in the form requiring an alternate disclosure format, we will match.

Thank you,
Hashtag Web3 - hi@hashtagweb3.com
